title: 雲境
logline: A plainly dressed young woman is brushed off by a snobbish sales consultant at 蓝城雲境; the sales director recognises her, she buys the show flat outright, and that night a call reveals she is acquiring the whole development.
music: elegant suspense underscore for a luxury urban drama, plucked strings, soft piano, low pulse, building to a cool confident reveal, instrumental, no vocals

clips.summary: {linwan} climbs the steps of the clubhouse and stops before the revolving door.
clips.soundscape: Light wind across the stone forecourt, distant birdsong, soft footsteps on stone.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: the grey stone steps and the bronze revolving door under the dark faceted canopy, {linwan} small in frame climbing the steps.
cuts.action: {linwan} climbs the last steps, the canvas tote over her shoulder, and stops in front of the revolving door.
cuts.camera: Slow crane down as she climbs.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwan} in front of the glass, the warm lobby glow behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan} stands before the glass with her head level and her eyes looking straight ahead at the revolving door, calm and steady, lips closed; she takes one slow breath, her right hand tightening on the tote strap, then steps forward toward the door.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, at eye level.

clips.summary: {zhaokai} intercepts {linwan} in the lobby, sizes up her clothes and quotes the price to get rid of her.
clips.soundscape: The hush of a vaulted marble lobby, a faint fountain trickle, footsteps echoing.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: the vaulted white ceiling, the dark red sculpture on the round marble inlay, {linwan} walking across the polished floor toward it, {zhaokai} striding in from the left to cut her off.
cuts.action: {zhaokai} steps into her path with a professional smile.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhaokai}, the sculpture soft behind him.
cuts.action: {zhaokai} looks her up and down, his eyes stopping on her sneakers and the canvas tote.
cuts.speaker: zhaokai
cuts.act: 上下打量她，假笑，语气敷衍
cuts.delivery: a fake polite smile, eyes flicking down to her sneakers

cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder from behind {zhaokai} onto {linwan}, the arched windows soft behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan} meets his eyes, unbothered.
cuts.camera: Slow push in on her face.
cuts.speaker: linwan
cuts.act: 平静，不卑不亢，语速很慢
cuts.delivery: calm and unbothered, meeting his eyes

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhaokai}, slightly lower angle, the vaulted ceiling above him.
cuts.action: {zhaokai} smiles thinly and lets the number hang.
cuts.speaker: zhaokai
cuts.line: 我们这儿最小的一套，两千八百万。
cuts.say: 我们这儿最小的一套……两千八百万。
cuts.act: 轻蔑地笑，故意把数字说得很慢
cuts.delivery: a thin contemptuous smile, saying the price slowly

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwan}, her eyes steady on him.
cuts.action: {linwan} looks at him without blinking; the corner of her mouth lifts very slightly.
cuts.camera: Rack focus from the blurred sculpture to her eyes.

clips.summary: {zhoumin} hurries in, recognises {linwan} and turns deferential; {zhaokai} freezes.
clips.soundscape: The lobby hush, quick heels on marble coming closer.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {zhoumin} coming fast out of the arched corridor, a phone in her hand.
cuts.action: {zhoumin} sees {linwan} and stops dead mid-stride.
cuts.camera: Handheld, tracking her, then stopping with her.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhoumin}, the lobby soft behind her.
cuts.action: {zhoumin} hurries the last steps to {linwan}, bowing slightly.
cuts.speaker: zhoumin
cuts.line: 林小姐？您怎么亲自过来了？
cuts.say: 林……林小姐？您怎么亲自过来了？
cuts.act: 又惊又慌，立刻换上恭敬的笑
cuts.delivery: startled, then instantly deferential, bowing slightly

cuts.composition: Close-up of {zhaokai}, the smile frozen on his face, his glasses catching the light.
cuts.action: {zhaokai}'s smile freezes; he swallows.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {linwan}, the sculpture's red blurred behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan} answers {zhoumin} without a glance at {zhaokai}.
cuts.speaker: linwan
cuts.delivery: flat and quiet, not even glancing at him

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhoumin}, turning her head to the side.
cuts.action: {zhoumin} turns to {zhaokai} with a fixed smile and glares at him.
cuts.camera: Quick whip of focus as she turns.
cuts.speaker: zhoumin
cuts.delivery: hissing at him through a fixed smile

clips.summary: In the show flat {linwan} walks to the window and buys it outright; {zhaokai} gapes in the doorway.
clips.soundscape: The quiet of an empty luxury flat, faint city hum through the glass.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: the floor-to-ceiling windows full of low sun, the curved sofa and the patterned rug, {linwan} walking to the window, {zhoumin} two steps behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan} stops at the glass and looks out over the gardens.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhoumin}, the window light on her face.
cuts.action: {zhoumin} gestures at the view, watching {linwan}'s face carefully.
cuts.speaker: zhoumin
cuts.line: 这一户是整个项目视野最好的。
cuts.say: 这一户……是整个项目视野最好的。
cuts.delivery: eager and careful, watching her face

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {linwan} against the bright window, her face in soft side light.
cuts.action: {linwan} keeps looking at the view as she answers.
cuts.speaker: linwan
cuts.act: 平静，像在买一杯咖啡，最后两个字轻轻落下
cuts.delivery: calm and offhand, as if ordering a coffee

cuts.composition: Close-up of {zhaokai} standing in the doorway behind them.
cuts.action: {zhaokai}'s mouth falls open.

clips.summary: {zhaokai} asks for the commission; {zhoumin} fires him.
clips.soundscape: The quiet flat, faint city hum.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhaokai}, the doorway behind him.
cuts.action: {zhaokai} hurries over, rubbing his hands with an ingratiating grin.
cuts.speaker: zhaokai
cuts.line: 林小姐，这一单能记在我名下吗？
cuts.say: 林小姐，这一单……能记在我名下吗？
cuts.delivery: an ingratiating grin, rubbing his hands

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwan}, the window light behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan} turns her head slowly to look at him, unreadable.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zhoumin}, not looking at him.
cuts.action: {zhoumin} speaks without turning her head.
cuts.speaker: zhoumin
cuts.act: 冷冷地，不看他，一字一顿
cuts.delivery: cold and final, not looking at him

cuts.composition: Close-up of {zhaokai}, slightly high angle.
cuts.action: All colour drains from {zhaokai}'s face; his glasses slip down his nose.

clips.summary: That night, alone at the window of the same flat, {linwan} takes a call: she is buying the whole development.
clips.soundscape: Night quiet in the flat, the faint low hum of the city through the glass.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc} at night, the city lights glowing beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows, {linwan} standing alone at the glass, a phone to her ear.
cuts.action: {linwan} stands still, looking out at the lights.

cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {linwan} by the window, the night city soft behind her, the phone at her ear.
cuts.action: {linwan} listens, her face lit by the warm lamp on one side and the blue city on the other.
cuts.speaker: zhoumin
cuts.line: 林董，蓝城雲境整个项目的收购协议，明早九点签。
cuts.say: 林董……蓝城雲境整个项目的收购协议，明早九点签。
cuts.act: 恭敬，压低声音，汇报的语气

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwan}, the city lights blurred behind her.
cuts.action: {linwan}'s mouth curves into a faint, knowing smile; she holds the look out at the city.
cuts.speaker: linwan
cuts.act: 淡淡地，嘴角带一点笑意
